[SWS_LOG_00251]
⌈
When ara::log::CreateLogger is called with
ara::core::InstanceSpecifier as a parameter, the CtxID, AppID, Ecu ID
and session ID shall be taken from the model and connections to logging sinks
shall be created for the returned Logger object. The InstanceSpecifier presents
a PortPrototype typed by LogAndTraceInterface or ServiceInterface ac-
cording to constr_5286, constr_5287.
⌋
